top_20_mass_market_audit.availability: in stock at Ham Radio Outlet; USD 15.95
top_20_mass_market_audit.functional_delta: same stated 25-1300-MHz receive range, but it is a remote magnetic-mount antenna with 12-ft RG-174 rather than a direct telescopic whip

top_20_mass_market_audit.best_mass_market_route: split the group: TE 001-0001 for S3 2.4 GHz; Taoglas GW.05.0153 for C5 2.4/5 GHz
top_20_mass_market_audit.availability: 001-0001: 2,656 Mouser stock; GW.05.0153: distributor stock and serial order route
top_20_mass_market_audit.functional_delta: S3 does not use 5 GHz, so its dual-band/IP67 capability is unused; C5 candidate begins at 5150 rather than 4910 MHz and both substitutions require assembled-device matching/EIRP closure

top_20_mass_market_audit.availability: in stock; USD 7.77
top_20_mass_market_audit.functional_delta: covers 136-174 and 400-470 MHz with standard SMA, but its public page does not close gain, VSWR, power or exact mechanical seating; it may cover both voice ports only after VNA and voice-TX HIL

top_20_mass_market_audit.best_mass_market_route: Ebyte TX433-JZR-6 for UHF plus TX433-JK-11 for the narrow 433-MHz port
top_20_mass_market_audit.availability: both serial Ebyte parts available from stocked distributors; TX433-JZR-6 observed at USD 1.72
top_20_mass_market_audit.functional_delta: UHF candidate preserves 400-480 MHz, 10 W and improves stated VSWR but nominal gain falls 3.3 to 3.0 dBi; the 433 candidate is narrow-band and both need VNA/EIRP HIL

top_20_mass_market_audit.availability: 638 immediate DigiKey stock; quantity-one and volume order routes
top_20_mass_market_audit.functional_delta: cheaper board-normal bodies have the wrong orientation; the checked through-hole pair collides with the accepted 5+5 mechanics and has no exact-one factory route

top_20_mass_market_audit.best_mass_market_route: retain the documented EastRising panel and touch pair
top_20_mass_market_audit.availability: direct serial quantity-one route; USD 14.91
top_20_mass_market_audit.functional_delta: cheaper generic 3.5-inch listings do not preserve the controlled FPC, i8080-8 pin map, ILI9488/FT6236 identity and factory-installable mechanical package

top_20_mass_market_audit.availability: JLCPCB overseas 2,978 / pre-order 2,977; MOQ 4; six required
top_20_mass_market_audit.functional_delta: cheaper detector families do not preserve the calibrated frequency/input/current contract and would require RF-chain redesign; the former LFCSP package already cost more

top_20_mass_market_audit.availability: WBC16-1TLC C22402290 is at zero JLCPCB stock; HenryTech C22383426 has 63 immediately shippable LCSC units at USD 1.0069 and is eligible for a JLCPCB Global Sourcing or Private Library request, but its exact Standard-PCBA route is not yet confirmed
top_20_mass_market_audit.functional_delta: the candidate preserves 1:16, 50-ohm and 0.6-160-MHz coverage but changes from the Coilcraft six-pad body to a five-pad 3.8-mm body; accept only after exact pin-map, insertion/return-loss and factory-placement checks

top_20_mass_market_audit.best_mass_market_route: retain B3S-1100P; source by JLC pre-order/consignment if necessary
top_20_mass_market_audit.availability: 33,662 DigiKey stock; JLCPCB C2733652 pre-order
top_20_mass_market_audit.functional_delta: B3S-1000P and cheap tact switches lose the grounded cover or exact force/life contract at the directly touched boundary

top_20_user_decision.scope: All six cheaper mass-market antenna candidates remain comparison evidence only and are not active qualification or BOM replacement routes.
top_20_user_decision.quantity_rule: Keep two separate ANT-433-CW-QW-SMA units: one permanently fitted to SUB-GHz and one to UHF VOICE. Manual antenna transfer is rejected because a wrong menu or port state could key a transmitter into a missing or incorrect load.

display_orientation_review.observed: The selected EastRising production drawings control the complete configured panel, 50-contact 0.50-mm tail, 0.30-mm stiffener, contact map and folded-tail orientation; donor geometry is not used.
display_orientation_review.accepted_rule: Physically orient the selected documented production panel so its flex points toward the antenna edge, then rotate display memory and touch coordinates in firmware. Do not allow the tail to enter the LED, D-pad or function-button zone.

paper_fit.firmware_change: ILI9488 display-memory rotation plus FT6236 touch-coordinate transform only

display_orientation_review.remaining_gate: The exact direct-ZIF geometry is closed; only written factory acceptance of customer-supplied panel PSA/FPC insertion plus incoming-lot conformity remain open.

accepted_cost_reduction_policy.primary_target: Eliminate avoidable small-lot pre-order penalties before reducing already-stocked material cost.
accepted_cost_reduction_policy.stocked_replacement_rule: Prefer a currently stocked JLCPCB part only when the electrical, RF, safety, lifecycle and mechanical contract is exact or no worse. If no such part exists, keep the selected MPN and its explicit pre-order route.
accepted_cost_reduction_policy.function_sensitive_rule: RF detectors, RF filters/couplers, power safety, battery protection and user-exposed ESD boundaries never change for price alone.
accepted_cost_reduction_policy.antenna_mechanics_rule: Prefer individually board-retained DIV-like right-angle SMA/RP-SMA bodies without nuts, sealing hardware or a shared protective frame. Low profile is not a requirement; a dual-face or through-board soldered load path is preferred. Keep the GCT pair only until a documented stocked standard/reverse pair passes the complete 5+5 placement, opposing-clearance and factory-assembly gate.

community_cost_target.scope: repeatable fully populated all-in-one device excluding batteries and the optional full external antenna kit; PCB, PCBA and enclosure must fit in the remaining complete-device allowance
community_cost_target.rule: The target is a hard cost-resynthesis gate for the current all-in-one architecture, not a promise for the first one-off factory order. A one-off order also carries setup, MOQ, hand-solder, shipping and tax costs that cannot be amortized.
community_cost_target.historical_community_entry_status: deferred until the fully populated R2-EVT1 works; no separate Core hardware variant is designed now

comparison_reference.finding: The published architecture is a much smaller one-S3 instrument: its shield BOM has three nRF24 modules, one CC1101 module, IR and a simple connector/passive layer. It is not burdened by Leshy2's two voice modules, Airband conversion chain, dual RP domains, three independent USB service paths, autonomous pack safety, actual-RF TX evidence and ten separately qualified RF ports. Retail volume and one-off factory procurement are also different price bases.

working_architecture_savings.current_scope: eight measurement-class RF detector ICs, five couplers and evidence conditioning
working_architecture_savings.contract: retain independent physical TX-present evidence for all three concurrently active nRF24 paths and fail-safe aggregate evidence for every other mutually exclusive TX group

working_architecture_savings.current_scope: sixteen grounded tact switches, one protected-cell holder and four keyed opened-sandwich recovery headers
working_architecture_savings.contract: retain recessed serial controls, protected-cell tolerance and independently reachable recovery for S3, C5 and both RP domains

working_architecture_savings.current_scope: duplicated audio selectors, branch supervisors, evidence logic and safe-state support circuitry
working_architecture_savings.contract: retain every accepted capture/playback/PTT route, unattended hard shutdown, watchdog, three thermal zones and retained first-fault reason

working_architecture_savings.current_scope: five U.FL receptacles, two 30-mm S3/C5 jumpers and three 60-mm nRF jumpers
working_architecture_savings.contract: retain the same RF performance; current E01 and S3 module interfaces prevent removing four paths without changing the selected radio source

same_all_in_one_result.scope: same built-in user-visible functions and same safety outcome, excluding batteries and the full external antenna kit
same_all_in_one_result.confidence: planning envelope only; it includes the accepted AD8314 package and Hirose U.FL packaging-route changes and still assumes successful remaining RF-evidence, audio/safety and internal-RF consolidation without changing the result, then adds USD 27-45 for PCB, PCBA and enclosure
same_all_in_one_result.assessment: The accepted AD8314 and Hirose U.FL packaging-route changes remove USD 10.4192 per device in total, while the cheaper antenna-connector candidate was rejected and contributes no saving. The USD 241-280 repeatable-complete band therefore remains an optimization hypothesis rather than a demonstrated bill; the current exact planning floor is reported separately. The accepted USD 220-260 target remains the gate and the sole first prototype remains higher.

modular_entry_result.scope: community entry device with the same software architecture and expansion compatibility, but selected specialist radio chains are bought as Caps/Units only when required
modular_entry_result.assessment: A USD 150 entry point is plausible only under this modular boundary. A fully populated system with every option and its antenna set still costs more.

accepted_strategy.current_first_prototype_rule: the sole R2-EVT1 may cost more because one-off factory penalties are not amortized
accepted_strategy.core_rule: do not create a separate Core PCB, BOM or product now; only preserve absent-device behavior and expansion boundaries so a community fit option can be evaluated after R2-EVT1

Код G Murata сохраняет корпус LQW15AN 0402, номинал 56 нГн, Q, минимальный SRF 2,8 ГГц, ток 200 мА и максимальный DCR 1,17 Ом, одновременно ужесточая допуск с +/-5 % до +/-2 %. C167482 есть на складе JLCPCB для Standard PCBA. Строка пяти устройств снижается с $0,3620 до $0,2235, экономия $0,1385; серийная материальная база уменьшается на $0,0277 на устройство.

current_stocked_candidate_checks.assembly_type: Extended SMT; Economic and Standard PCBA
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why: The stocked member preserves the 6.6 x 6.0 x 4.3-mm body, 1.57-N feel, 500k endurance and IP67 family boundary, but removes the fifth cover-ground terminal. That can weaken the user-exposed ESD path, so the current B3S-1100P remains selected until an equivalent grounded stocked part is proven.
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why_ru: Складской вариант сохраняет корпус 6,6 × 6,0 × 4,3 мм, усилие 1,57 Н, ресурс 500 тысяч нажатий и IP67, но лишён пятого вывода заземления крышки. Это может ухудшить ESD-защиту доступной пользователю клавиши, поэтому B3S-1100P остаётся выбранной до доказательства равноценной складской замены.

current_stocked_candidate_checks.assembly_type: Extended SMT; Economic and Standard PCBA; assembly fixture required
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why: The stocked 6.15 x 6.15 x 4.5-mm IP67 SMT body would reduce sixteen quantity-one switches from USD 14.50 to USD 0.79, but it raises force from 1.57 N to 2.6 N, removes the fifth grounded-cover terminal from the directly finger-operated user boundary and the exact order code does not disclose a guaranteed 500k-cycle life. Those are functional, ESD and feel regressions rather than a free saving, so it is not selected.
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why_ru: Складской SMT-корпус 6,15 x 6,15 x 4,5 мм с IP67 снизил бы цену шестнадцати кнопок при количестве 1 с $14,50 до $0,79, но усилие возрастает с 1,57 до 2,6 Н, исчезает пятый заземлённый вывод крышки на доступной пальцу границе, а для точного кода не заявлен гарантированный ресурс 500 тысяч нажатий. Это ухудшение функции, ESD и ощущений, а не бесплатная экономия, поэтому деталь не выбрана.

current_stocked_candidate_checks.assembly_type: Extended SMT; Standard PCBA only; high assembly difficulty
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why: The stocked gold-plated single-cell holder is factory placeable and cheaper, but its 77.05 x 20.65-mm drawing does not prove the selected long protected button-top XTAR envelope, dual-cell mechanical polarization before contact or the current four-independent-contact body. Two pieces therefore do not constitute a no-worse replacement for 1048P.
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why_ru: Складской позолоченный держатель одного элемента устанавливается фабрикой и дешевле, но его чертёж 77,05 x 20,65 мм не доказывает посадку выбранного длинного защищённого button-top XTAR, механическую защиту двух элементов от переполюсовки до касания контактов и текущий единый корпус с четырьмя независимыми контактами. Поэтому две такие детали не являются равноценной заменой 1048P.

current_stocked_candidate_checks.jlcpcb_part: not applicable; bare PCB pads and locating holes
current_stocked_candidate_checks.assembly_type: no fitted board component; one external reusable cable required
current_stocked_candidate_checks.trial_required_quantity: four PCB footprints plus one reusable cable
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why: The keyed spring-probe footprint would save all four board headers in a repeated build, but the exact-one prototype would first require a USD 39 cable, versus USD 5.64 for four currently stocked Samtec headers at JLCPCB. It also replaces a hands-free long-session connection with a dedicated probe workflow. Keep the stocked Samtec parts for EVT1; Tag-Connect remains a post-EVT1 volume option.
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why_ru: Ключевая пружинная площадка убрала бы все четыре разъёма из повторяемой BOM, но для единственного прототипа сначала потребуется кабель за $39 вместо $5,64 за четыре текущих складских Samtec в JLCPCB. Кроме того, свободное длительное подключение сменится отдельным probe-процессом. Для EVT1 сохраняются складские Samtec; Tag-Connect остаётся вариантом после EVT1 при серийном удешевлении.

current_stocked_candidate_checks.assembly_type: Extended SMT; Economic and Standard PCBA
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why: The JLCPCB cards prove a 6-GHz standard/reverse pair and the controlled HenryTech drawings prove individual retention without a nut, but both bodies point normal to the PCB. They do not replace the selected edge-facing GCT bodies without changing antenna direction and product form.
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why_ru: Карточки JLCPCB подтверждают standard/reverse-пару до 6 ГГц, а контролируемые чертежи HenryTech — индивидуальное удержание без гайки, но оба корпуса направлены перпендикулярно плате. Они не заменяют выбранные торцевые GCT без смены направления антенн и формы продукта.

current_stocked_candidate_checks.assembly_type: Plugin; JLCPCB page currently marks manualWeld; Standard PCBA route requires order review
current_stocked_candidate_checks.stock: 5479 pre-sale + 5588 overseas standard / 7 pre-sale + 42 overseas reverse
current_stocked_candidate_checks.trial_required_quantity: 8 standard / 2 reverse fitted; procurement minimum 13 standard / 12 reverse
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why: The exact DreamLNK drawings confirm a robust no-nut, five-pin through-board 6-GHz pair, but also close the fit question negatively for the accepted mock-up. Each 9.7 x 9.7-mm outer body enters an upper 4-mm compression-stop head keep-out at both edge ports on each PCB, while the 5.08 x 5.08-mm pin pattern intersects the display connector, two native-RF couplers, the Airband reserve and CC1101 area on the inner faces. Fixing this would require moving the accepted structural axes or compressing the 5+5 bank and relocating RF bodies. The JLCPCB route is still Plugin/manualWeld with 13/12 procurement minima and no exact-one assembly quote. This is not a drop-in no-loss saving, so the selected GCT pair remains.
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why_ru: Точные чертежи DreamLNK подтверждают прочную standard/reverse-пару до 6 ГГц без гаек с пятью сквозными выводами, но одновременно отрицательно закрывают вопрос посадки в принятом мокапе. Каждый внешний корпус 9,7 x 9,7 мм входит в 4-мм keep-out головки верхней compression-stop у крайних портов обеих плат, а рисунок выводов 5,08 x 5,08 мм пересекает разъём дисплея, два coupler native-RF, резерв Airband и область CC1101 на внутренних сторонах. Исправление потребует переноса принятых силовых осей либо сжатия ряда 5+5 и перемещения RF-компонентов. Маршрут JLCPCB всё ещё Plugin/manualWeld с минимумами закупки 13/12 и без цены сборки ровно одного устройства. Это не drop-in экономия без потерь, поэтому выбранная пара GCT остаётся.

optimization_lanes.title: Rebuild the external antenna kit from stocked no-worse equivalents
optimization_lanes.evidence: Eight of twelve exact first-target antenna profiles already contribute USD 138.3166 per device, while three nRF24 antennas and the controlled AM/LW receive pod remain unpriced. This is the largest separate material group even though it sits outside the base PCBA BOM.
optimization_lanes.action: Keep every accepted band and all band-specific TX matching. Search the current factory/order surface for exact or no-worse connector, band, power and matching equivalents; optimize receive-only profiles separately and never silently substitute one generic whip for a qualified TX antenna.

optimization_lanes.title: Replace safe equivalent pre-order passives and ordinary logic with in-stock JLCPCB parts
optimization_lanes.evidence: After seven safe replacement batches, 27 pre-order rows cost USD 660.0144 in the normalized five-device evidence versus USD 331.0265 on their quantity-100 material basis. The stocked Nexperia, YAGEO, UNI-ROYAL, FH, Hirose, TI, Vishay and Murata routes together remove approximately USD 140.8195 from the observed trial route and reduce the public material basis by a net USD 8.0045 per device.
optimization_lanes.action: Review every pre-order row against its substitution class; only exact or no-worse parametric replacements may be accepted.

optimization_lanes.title: Retain the GCT pair after the cheaper through-hole pair fails the complete 5+5 gate
optimization_lanes.evidence: Ten GCT RFPC-SMA31/32 connectors contribute USD 24.6456 per device. Exact drawings close the tempting DreamLNK alternative: four outer bodies conflict with the accepted upper compression-stop head keep-outs and five port groups conflict with inner-face bodies/reserves; the factory route also remains manualWeld without an exact-one quote.
optimization_lanes.action: Keep the accepted dual-face GCT pair. Reopen only for a factory-placeable standard/reverse pair that retains outward orientation and 6-GHz native-port coverage, passes the unchanged 5+5 plus compression-stop geometry and has a complete exact-one order route.

optimization_lanes.title: Use the factory-routable AD8314 MSOP package without weakening real-TX evidence
optimization_lanes.evidence: Six accepted AD8314ARMZ-REEL plus two retained LTC5532 now contribute USD 19.4142 per device on the common quantity-100 basis. C652687 has an explicit Extended-SMT Standard-PCBA pre-order/overseas route, MOQ 4, and the exact-one device needs six. The full packages, five couplers and eight local evidence allocations pass H1-R2.36 geometry.
optimization_lanes.action: Keep C652687 and the two LTC5532; carry all eight local evidence allocations into the new R2 H2 schematic/layout and preserve independent evidence for the three concurrently active nRF24 paths.

optimization_lanes.title: Retain the grounded Omron family for all sixteen ordinary controls
optimization_lanes.evidence: B3S-1100P contributes USD 10.248 per device at quantity 100. Two stocked alternatives were checked: B3S-1000P preserves feel, height, endurance and ingress but removes the grounded cover; TSG002A04526A is dramatically cheaper but also removes that terminal, raises force to 2.6 N and does not prove the exact 500k-cycle life. Because every control is directly finger-operated without a cap or plunger, neither is no-worse.
optimization_lanes.action: Keep B3S-1100P for the present architecture. Reopen only for an exact factory-placeable part that preserves the grounded user boundary, approximately 1.6-N force, 4.3-mm reach, IP67 and at least 500k cycles, or after a future enclosure revision makes the metal cover physically inaccessible.

optimization_lanes.title: Retain all five U.FL plus 30-mm jumper paths after source-to-port review
optimization_lanes.evidence: The five paths now contribute USD 9.517 per device at quantity 100 after the exact stocked Hirose packaging-route change, before assembly handling. S3 and all three E01 modules expose only microcoax RF outputs, and each path must still pass through its local coupler and real-TX detector before SMA. The current C5 module also exposes U.FL; an exact stocked Espressif T2/ANT2 factory route is not proved.
optimization_lanes.action: Therefore 0/5 paths can be removed safely now. A future qualified C5 T2 route could remove one path and save about USD 1.90 per device.

optimization_lanes.title: Retain 1048P until a complete protected-cell holder is proven
optimization_lanes.evidence: 1048P contributes USD 8.57 per device at quantity 100 and remains a pre-order route, but the checked stocked MYOUNG holders are single-cell bodies or loose contacts that do not prove the selected protected button-top length, dual-cell pre-contact polarity blocking and enclosure-supported four-contact mechanism.
optimization_lanes.action: Keep 1048P as a justified safety/mechanical part for EVT1. Reopen only for a serial factory-placeable dual holder that proves the complete XTAR envelope and transfers insertion/removal load through the enclosure rather than the solder joints.

optimization_lanes.title: Retain four stocked Samtec DBG10 headers for the exact-one EVT1
optimization_lanes.evidence: The corrected R2 count is four, not three. Exact C2932107 is currently JLCPCB Extended SMT stock with 890 pieces, 887 orderable, MOQ 1 and USD 1.41 at quantity 1. Four headers therefore cost USD 5.64 on the exact-one factory route. A TC2050-IDC footprint would remove the fitted parts but requires a USD 39 reusable cable and changes long-session debug ergonomics.
optimization_lanes.action: Keep four FTSH-105-01-L-DV-K-P-TR headers for independent S3/C5/Hub-RP/RF-RP recovery. Reconsider Tag-Connect only after EVT1 when its one-time cable cost can be amortized and the service workflow can be tested.

optimization_lanes.title: Do not optimize away the selected serial production panel
optimization_lanes.evidence: EastRising ER-TFT035IPS-6 plus ER-TPC035-6 contributes USD 14.91 and already provides a controlled drawing, ILI9488/FT6236, direct i8080-8 and quantity-one serial ordering. The donor route is gone.
optimization_lanes.action: Treat the display material cost as justified. Only the assembler fee and written acceptance of panel/FPC final mating remain open; do not restart display selection for a small speculative saving.
